title: Rigby2D 0.4.1 is here. Our biggest release yet.
author: Scared-Sandwich1283
selftext:
Rigby2D now runs on Windows, macOS and Linux, with runtimes for Unity, Godot and Phaser.

A few weeks ago, I started sharing Rigby2D here. Since then, we've been pushing it well beyond the original editor. Version 0.4 is a massive step forward, and the goal hasn't changed: **a free, open-source 2D skeletal animation tool you can actually use to ship games and make films.**

🌐 **Try it in your browser:** [https://rigby2d.com/editor/](https://rigby2d.com/editor/)

📦 **Download for desktop:** [https://rigby2d.com](https://rigby2d.com/)

💻 **Source code:** [https://github.com/jaisurya-dev-art/rigby2d](https://github.com/jaisurya-dev-art/rigby2d)

# What's new in 0.4

**🖥️ Windows, macOS and Linux**

Native desktop builds are now available across all three platforms, including a universal macOS build for Apple Silicon and Intel, plus Linux AppImage and .deb packages.

**🎮 Take your animations straight into your engine**

The runtimes are free to use and ship. No runtime licensing fees.

* **Unity:** Unity 2021.3+ and Unity 6, Built-in and URP.
* **Godot 4:** Windows, macOS and Linux.
* **Phaser 3:** Load and create Rigby2D animations with `this.load.rigby()` and `this.add.rigby()`.
* **JavaScript and Rust:** Additional runtime support.

The Unity runtime is built for multithreaded playback with zero garbage allocation during animation updates. In our benchmark, 200 animated characters take around 5 ms per frame on a 4-core laptop.

You can also get the matching runtimes directly through **File → Get runtimes**.

**🛟 A much safer workflow**

Atomic saves, `.rigby1` backups, autosave, crash recovery and unsaved-change protection. Your work shouldn't disappear because an application crashed or closed unexpectedly.

**👋 A proper welcome screen**

Start a project, pick up recent work, explore starter projects or jump straight into tutorials. There's even a playable Phaser starter featuring NILA.

**🧩 An add-on system**

Python add-ons now have a gallery inside Preferences. Three official add-ons are included to get started: Mirror Tools, Breathing Idle and Rig Report. Scripts run inside a sandbox designed to prevent filesystem and network access.

**🔄 Signed automatic updates**

The desktop app can update itself, with signed updates built into the workflow.

**🌏 Six languages**

English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese.

# Already using another animation tool?

**DragonBones:** Open projects directly, with bones, weighted meshes, IK, skins and animations converted automatically.

**Spine:** Import JSON and `.skel` exports from versions 3.8 to 4.3, with a built-in compatibility checker to show what carries over before switching.

# And the core editor is still here

* **AutoRig:** Turn layered PSD artwork into a rig.
* **Rigging:** Meshes, weights, IK, physics and path constraints.
* **Animation:** Graph editor, onion skinning and pose library.
* **Film workflow:** Audio-driven lip-sync, MP4/WebM rendering and multi-character scenes.
* **MCP server:** Let AI assistants work with your rigs and animations.
* **Demos:** Explore NILA and Rigbytron projects.

Rigby2D is still an independent project, and there's a lot more I want to build.

If you're a game developer, animator or technical artist, give 0.4 a try. Break it, make something with it, and tell me what's missing. Bug reports, contributions and feature requests are all welcome.

**MIT / Apache-2.0 · Free and open source.**

⭐ GitHub: [https://github.com/jaisurya-dev-art/rigby2d](https://github.com/jaisurya-dev-art/rigby2d)

*The macOS and Linux builds are fresh, so if something doesn't work on your machine, please open an issue. I'll get on it.*
